meaning: Recorded recipients are not automatically original contributing wallets or humans; protocol addresses can receive conversion outputs.
All phase28 flags remain, including the indirect claim flag which generic phase30 output matching does not resolve.
Two transactions each link an NFT purchase and a conversion to different recipients; their financial meaning must not be double-counted.
Only native18 historical DTF and WETH Transfer-event sums are derived. These are not balances, ETH expenditure, original-contribution amounts, compensation deductions or migration credit.

No matching events or zero emitted net flow does not prove zero capital contribution. Native wrapping, unwrapping, internal value/refunds, fees, other assets and multi-action transactions remain separate.
Outer value is transaction-level context, not an allocation to every recipient.
No frozen source, candidate, financial approval or operational loader is modified.
